coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

behavior.arguments: rdi = container, rsi = index; all comparisons unsigned pointers
behavior.formula: load(rdi, rsi) = 0 if [rdi+0x988] == [rdi+0x990] (empty container) else qword[[rdi+0x988] + 16*rsi]
behavior.non_empty_path: shl $0x4,%rsi then mov (begin,%rsi,1),%rax at 0x4fec818; return the element's first qword
behavior.index_bound_check: none; the only guard is emptiness (begin == end). The index is scaled and dereferenced without re-checking it against the element count.
behavior.zero_result_ambiguity: a 0 return is produced both by an empty container and by a non-empty element whose stored first qword is 0; the caller cannot distinguish the two from the return value alone
behavior.output_shape: single qword in rax (a pointer or value whose contract is not claimed)

incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_slots_note: no R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as its addend; the window is reached only by the single direct e8 call at 0x4fb2546
incoming_pattern_scan.caller_note: the sole caller at 0x4fb2546 (function head 0x4fb2530) forwards its 2nd and 3rd arguments as (rdi, rsi), then null-checks the result with test %rax,%rax ; je, exercising the empty-guard return path
